body:
## Objective

Define and execute the remaining evidence program needed to resolve the V8-next economic gate while preserving NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM until all required authority receipts are independently verified.

## Owning authority

- Constitution Rule 12
- D-153 benchmark and economic evidence scope
- Existing V8-next issues #377, #380, #383, and #385

## Change class

BENCHMARK_EVALUATION

## Current state

The current benchmark certificate correctly reports:

    NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM

The status dashboard also reports unresolved or absent evidence across protected OOS/search-family accounting, funding/cost finality, external parity, and live/prospective realization. This is a correct safety state, not a defect to suppress.

## Required end state

- A preregistered evidence matrix maps each economic gate to its required physical inputs, method, artifact, and independent verification.
- Eligible real outcome samples are available before any statistical result is interpreted.
- WRC/DSR/SPA or the constitutionally required methods consume real, provenance-bound data.
- Protected OOS, funding/venue-cost, parity, and prospective realization evidence are tracked without double use.
- The final status remains NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM until a valid authority receipt exists.
- Any failure or underpowered result remains explicit and blocks promotion.

## Expected file / module surface

- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/runner.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/gate_resolution.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/economic_benchmark.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/parity.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/overfitting.py
- v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/store.py
- v8-next/tests and evidence/report artifacts as authorized

## Verification gates

    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev --extra research pytest -q v8-next/tests
    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev --extra research python -m v8_next.app.cli status
    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev --extra research python -m v8_next.app.cli benchmark --diagnostic-only

The program must fail closed when any required input is absent, mismatched, underpowered, or non-independent.

## Required evidence artifacts

- Preregistered gate/evidence matrix
- Real-data manifests and hashes
- Statistical outputs with method/version/plan identity
- Protected-OOS and lineage receipts
- Parity and venue/funding reconciliation artifacts
- Independent review/verification log

## Non-goals / forbidden scope

- No p-value, Sharpe, PBO, DSR, or effect-size fabrication.
- No synthetic or offset outcome inputs.
- No opening of protected OOS without explicit authority.
- No live-money activation.
- No conversion of NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM into a positive claim through dashboard scoring.

## Requirements

- R1: Map every economic gate to its required input and artifact.
- R2: Preserve complete trial and lineage accounting.
- R3: Use only eligible real outcomes.
- R4: Keep the claim firewall closed until receipt verification passes.
- R5: Report missing, failed, and underpowered evidence separately.

## Dependencies

- #377 protected OOS/search-family evidence
- #380 funding finality and coverage
- #383 external parity
- #385 venue-cost calibration
- #379 fills/latency/shortfall/reconciliation

## Base SHA

1563d8955c6e9c47e3909037cdcdeb5961ffc800

## Evidence

PENDING
title: [RESEARCH] V8-next: close the economic evidence gate without weakening NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM
